title: A Clean Slate for Offline Reinforcement Learning

predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: Abstract claims 'achieving average training speedups of 131.5× and 74.8× against OfflineRL-Kit and CORL', but the actual speedups reported in the paper (Figure 5 and Appendix Table 2) are in the range 4–20×, nowhere near the claimed averages. No computation from the provided timing data can produce those numbers, so the abstract's claim is false.

predicted_errors.error_location: Section 4.1 ('single-file reimplementations of a range of existing model-free (BC, TD3-BC, ReBRAC, IQL, SAC-N, LB-SAC, EDAC, CQL, DT)')
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The algorithm 'LB-SAC' is listed among model-free methods but is never defined, described, or mentioned elsewhere in the paper (including Appendix A). There is no known offline RL algorithm with this name, and it does not appear in the taxonomy or implementation details. This appears to be an undefined and possibly erroneous reference.

predicted_errors.error_location: Section 5.1 ('TD3-AWR outperforms ReBRAC on several datasets but underperforms or matches it on others, such as pen-human and kitchen-mixed.')
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: Figure 6 and the full results in Appendix J clearly show TD3-AWR achieving a markedly higher mean score than ReBRAC on pen-human-v1 (TD3-AWR ~65-70, ReBRAC ~40). The text incorrectly claims that TD3-AWR underperforms or matches ReBRAC on this dataset, contradicting the provided evidence.

predicted_errors.error_location: Section 4.2 vs Appendix I.2 (unified actor loss)
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: In Section 4.2, the unified actor loss is written as L_actor = β_q · L_q + β_BC · L_BC − β_H · H(π(·|s_t)) + β_div · L_div + β_dyn · L_dyn, while Appendix I.2 states the same loss without the β_div and β_dyn terms. This discrepancy means the formal definition of the unified algorithm is inconsistent between the main text and the detailed appendix.

The cases environment requires explicit conditions for each branch, but none are given. The equation as written does not specify when to use the value function v(s_{t+1}) versus the minimum over critics, making the expression mathematically ill-formed and impossible to implement without further inference.

The variable \tilde{a}_{t+1} is used without any definition. It is unclear whether it denotes the dataset action, a target action from a teacher policy, or something else. The paper provides no explanation, leaving the equation ambiguous and unreproducible.
